title: gyrotaenia crassifolia
intro: Gyrotaenia crassifolia, commonly known as Sweet Woodruff, is a perennial herb belonging to the Apiaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and act as an antioxidant, thereby protecting against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Sweet Woodruff are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including coumarins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. Furthermore, the plant's bioactive constituents may also possess immunomodulatory and hepatoprotective effects, supporting its traditional use in folk medicine.
